name: OTL (Office True Love) ~Damee, Shigoto Chuu na no ni... Zecchou ga Tomaranai noo~
original_name: OTL（オフィストゥルーラブ） ～だめぇ、仕事中なのに…絶頂が止まらないのぉ～
source:
The main character, a job-hunter, goes to an entrance exam for Office True Love, an adult goods production and sales company he stumbled upon on the Internet.

There, the company president somehow took a liking to him, and he was hired on the condition that he “produce business results by a certain deadline!

He arrives at “OTL” in high spirits, and to his surprise, all of the employees are beautiful women with unique personalities.
The main character cooperates with these beautiful employees to create a multitude of sex toys.

The main character develops revolutionary adult goods such as “penis enlargement drug” “tentacle robot,” “breast augmentation gel,” “automatic bondage rope,” and “pseudo-penis."

Since they are adult goods, tons of naughtiness happens, of course!
